selection_note: Five small independent functions selected before GCC experiments. Diagnostic coverage only, not a statistical sample of the game. Complete instructions and local literal pools included. The first inferred name was corrected from mask_clear to mask_any after reviewing TST/SUBC semantics; addresses and compared ranges did not change.

boundary_review.method: Manual review of contiguous SH-4 instructions, control-flow exits, delay slots, referenced literal pools, and next function start; cross-checked against Ghidra function entries.
boundary_review.confidence: high for byte boundaries; names, types, and gameplay meanings inferred
